scope.deployment_overview: Two principal ROS processes: navigation_runtime and px4_navigation_external_mode. FAST-LIO is a separate estimator process. Combined bringup launches runtime and PX4 mode; estimator launch is separate. PX4 mode executable owns an external-mode executor plus a state-input node/thread.
limitations: Mermaid CLI was absent at initial capture; a follow-up isolated install rendered and visually checked all four Mermaid sequences
several runCycle branches and uncommon exception/cancellation paths need follow-up semantic review

Two source-comment/config descriptions conflict with executable policy: airborne goal publication is conditional; SIM_TIME with zero tracking coefficients activates tracking/health suppression. Both are recorded as source-vs-comment conflicts, not reconciled by inference.
scope.profile: Static analysis of captured local working tree; checked-in default mapping config declares sitl. No live launch/build profile established.

objects.instance: embedded in NavigationRuntimeNode; mutex-protected snapshot is runtime lifecycle authority
objects.decision_authority: execution phase/recovery lifecycle, active generation, command availability, suffix and failure latch

objects.instance: embedded in NavigationRuntimeNode; owns active and pending immutable CandidateBundle
objects.decision_authority: authoritative active/pending bundle, activation, commit/revoke and final publication serialization

objects.instance: embedded in NavigationRuntimeNode; read-only sampler over timeline snapshot
objects.decision_authority: sample role/time from current active bundle; no commit or activation authority

objects.instance: embedded in NavigationRuntimeNode; single pending goal slot
objects.decision_authority: retain/consume a same-mission ordered goal behind active moving safety suffix
admit NavigationCommand into local cache; mission callback; convert cached PVA to PX4 setpoint inputs; request Hold via executor callback

objects.instance: unique_ptr owned by NavigationMode per loaded mission
objects.decision_authority: airborne gating, measured waypoint acceptance, retry, terminal hold/dwell, mission Complete/Failure event
request AUTO_LOITER through PX4 API and track API result / VehicleStatus confirmation

objects.instance: pure helpers used by NavigationMode admission and setpoint path
objects.decision_authority: reject malformed, stale, wrong-frame or wrong-identity message; does not observe PX4 controller acceptance

objects.instance: embedded store and worker in NavigationRuntimeNode
objects.decision_authority: publish current world snapshot identity/revision; world validator supplies candidate validation

objects.instance: one backend referenced by worker; solver call can overlap command sampling
objects.decision_authority: produce candidate result; not independently allowed to expose it to PX4

fields.name: active_goal_
fields.initialization: empty; set after validated goal ingress; cleared on epoch reset/fail-closed paths
fields.meaning: runtime desired request identity and route payload
readers: currentPlanningKey
runCycle request snapshot
candidate admission/activation guard
publishCommand identity checks
fields.reset: clear on localization reset/fail closed; replaced only after goal validation
fields.clock_unit: ROS header stamp in goal; no timer stored in field
fields.identity: mission_id, waypoint_index, request_id, route_revision, active_goal_epoch
fields.protection: input_mutex_ under canonical localization->input->command transition order

fields.name: executing_goal_
fields.initialization: empty; may remain old while desired PASS_THROUGH successor is pending
fields.meaning: goal identity corresponding to physical command timeline; changes on immediate commit or pending activation
readers: command timeline/current planning key checks
publishCommand final exposure
recovery attribution
fields.reset: cleared/reinitialized at reset/revocation; swapped on timeline cutover
fields.identity: goal tuple + command_goal_epoch + bundle generation
fields.protection: input_mutex_ and command transition mutex; timeline finalization is separate store boundary

fields.name: PendingGoalHandoffOwner::pending_goal_
fields.initialization: empty
fields.meaning: single latest admissible same-mission goal deferred while moving safety suffix owns execution
writers: enqueue after goal admission under suffix guard
readers: measured-stop handoff and pending goal consumption
timeline activation guard
fields.reset: consume exact pointer after successor cutover or clear on invalidation/foreign mission
fields.identity: mission/waypoint/request and localization/goal epoch recheck
fields.protection: owner mutex plus runtime transition locks

fields.name: active_goal_epoch_
fields.meaning: monotonic runtime goal/request invalidation token; distinct from request id
readers: PlanningKey/request validation
candidate admission/commit/activation/publication
fields.reset: incremented/bumped by goal and lifecycle changes; zero is invalid in candidate identity
fields.identity: not interchangeable with localization_epoch or request_id
fields.protection: atomic plus transition locks for compound state

fields.name: active_localization_epoch_ / localization_epoch_ready_
fields.initialization: epoch 1 / ready true
fields.meaning: state/map coordinate lifetime and readiness latch; reset blocks command exposure until new world/state is established
readers: state input, PlanningKey, candidate validate/commit and final command exposure
fields.reset: higher epoch drains/cancels and invalidates; readiness restored only after reset requirements
fields.identity: PropagatedOdometry.localization_epoch, health epoch, world identity
fields.protection: atomics and localization_transition_mutex_

fields.name: ExecutionEpisode::Snapshot::recovery_state
fields.initialization: InitialHold; state resides in mutex-protected Episode snapshot
fields.meaning: runtime's physical execution recovery authority; pure transition helper alone does not commit state
fields.scope: one execution episode and active candidate identity
readers: planning admission/key, candidate commit, sample handling, command role policy
fields.reset: beginGoal or failClosed changes episode; exact generation checks reject stale mutators
fields.identity: goal epoch, localization epoch, request id, active bundle generation
fields.protection: ExecutionEpisode mutex plus runtime compound transition locks

fields.name: Snapshot::failure_latched / command_execution_lease_failure_latch_
fields.initialization: false / allows initial exposure
fields.meaning: fail-closed command stop; latch serializes one-time lease failure while episode denies command
readers: commit/activation/sample/publication guards
fields.reset: explicit fresh lifecycle/reset only; no automatic expiry
fields.identity: current command goal and execution epoch
fields.protection: episode mutex and latch transitionMutex_

fields.name: active_ / pending_ / version_
fields.initialization: empty; updates through guarded store methods
fields.meaning: sole runtime committed/executing command bundle authority; pending does not execute before due activation
readers: CommandSampler, candidate prep/admission, publishIfCurrent, diagnostics
fields.reset: revoke/invalidate on identity/world/state/lifecycle failure
fields.identity: world snapshot identity, goal/localization epoch, request id, bundle generation, txn/version
fields.protection: store mutex and compare-token rechecks

fields.name: active_ / pending_
fields.type: active job + optional latest pending job
fields.initialization: none; started with worker
fields.meaning: one serial planner and one replaceable pending request; queue state is scheduling, not execution authority
readers: worker loop, status snapshots, runtime scheduling
fields.reset: pending replacement/drop and shutdown/join
fields.clock_unit: steady clock for runtime watchdog; job keys include stamps
fields.identity: PlanningKey incl localization/goal/request/world/dynamics identity
fields.protection: worker mutex; planner backend recursive mutex for run/cancel path
roles: authoritative control state for queue only

fields.name: navigation_command_
fields.initialization: empty; invalidated at activate/deactivate
fields.meaning: last locally admitted ROS command snapshot; not evidence of PX4 application
readers: updateMission continuation/terminal witness
updateSetpoint PVA and lease gates
fields.reset: invalidate on activation/deactivation, terminal fail/handover and selected command changes
fields.clock_unit: ROS source/valid_until plus steady receive stamp
fields.identity: mission/waypoint/request/epochs/world/generation/sample id
fields.protection: trajectory_mutex_ serializes with mission timer and cache mutations

fields.name: active_waypoint_index_ / request_id_ / route_progress_
fields.initialization: mission start/checkpoint on activate; request advances monotonically
fields.meaning: PX4-side mission progression identity based on accepted measured evidence
readers: update guard, goal publisher, command identity admission
fields.reset: reactivation resumes checkpoint and increments request; mission replacement constructs controller
fields.clock_unit: seconds for internal retry/progress sample timing
fields.identity: mission id + waypoint index + request id + route revision
fields.protection: MissionController mutex; called under NavigationMode trajectory_mutex for cross-object linearization

fields.name: trajectory_ready_
fields.initialization: false/reset on activation; on accepted trajectory set true
fields.meaning: mode-side readiness latch gates mission progression and initial planner acquisition; does not prove command currently leased
readers: MissionController::update and state transitions
fields.reset: false on goal replacement, deactivation, error; set by admissible command trajectory
fields.identity: current MissionController request, but NavigationCommand admission has separate correlation checks
fields.protection: MissionController mutex

fields.name: terminal_hold_pending_ / pending_position_control_
fields.initialization: false; activated on STOP or safety fallback paths
fields.meaning: separate mission-level terminal settling and requested mode handover flags; neither equals measured stop, waypoint accepted, or mission complete
writers: onTrajectory role/kind transitions; update STOP/safety timeout; deactivate/reset
readers: MissionController::update branch order; NavigationMode event handling
fields.reset: cleared only after measured confirmation or explicit lifecycle transition
fields.identity: current mission waypoint/request
fields.protection: MissionController mutex under trajectory lock at mode boundary

fields.name: safety_suffix_handoff_pending_ + waypoint/request tuple
fields.initialization: false/zero; set when retaining a matching BACKUP command across waypoint handoff
fields.meaning: PX4-side permission to admit exact old safety suffix while new goal is being planned; not the runtime pending-goal owner
readers: onNavigationCommand identity admission, updateMission suffix-stop decision
fields.reset: first accepted new-goal command, lifecycle reset, or safety handover
fields.identity: old backup waypoint/request plus new current request
fields.protection: trajectory_mutex_

fields.name: planner_recovery_pending_ + deadline + identity
fields.initialization: false; timer starts on specific terminal/completed command recovery path
fields.meaning: adapter-side bounded window waiting for fresh planner command after endpoint; separate from runtime ExecutionEpisode::StoppedRecovery
writers: updateSetpoint completed command branch and clear/reset helper
readers: updateSetpoint fresh/stale command handling, updateMission timeout
fields.reset: fresh admissible command, lifecycle/handover, or timeout/failure
fields.identity: mode-side mission/wp/request/bundle generation
fields.protection: trajectory_mutex_

fields.name: px4_local_frame_aligned_ / PX4 reset counters
fields.initialization: false; align from stationary paired LIO/PX4 observations
fields.meaning: frame witness gates ENU-to-PX4 setpoint conversion and invalidates on PX4 reset
readers: updateSetpoint coordinate conversion and safety checks
fields.reset: clear when PX4 XY/Z reset counter changes or mode lifecycle resets
fields.clock_unit: PX4 reset counters and source/steady stamps
fields.identity: PX4 frame reset counters + localization epoch
fields.protection: trajectory_mutex_

fields.name: handover_requested_ / mission_terminal_ / failure_reported_
fields.initialization: false on activation
fields.meaning: NavigationMode terminal/failure handover gate; command arrival cannot reopen mission after terminal handover
readers: command admission, setpoint, mission timer
fields.reset: on activate; set terminal/failure independently by events
fields.identity: mission and current request
fields.protection: trajectory_mutex_ for compound snapshots

fields.name: px4_hold_confirmed_ / hold_handover_pending_ / hold_handover_in_flight_
fields.initialization: false/0 on executor activate
fields.meaning: API scheduling, API completion, and observed VehicleStatus AUTO_LOITER are distinct; vehicle status is confirmation
writers: request callback, schedulePx4Hold/API result, VehicleStatus callback, lifecycle reset
readers: 50 ms timer retry predicate
fields.reset: confirmed AUTO_LOITER clears pending/in-flight; activation/deactivation clears all
fields.clock_unit: steady ns retry timestamp, 250 ms after API failure
fields.identity: held vehicle mode, no mission bundle id
fields.protection: executor callbacks/timer; serialization from PX4 executor not inferred beyond source

fields.name: CandidateBundle.valid_from_ns / valid_until_ns + NavigationCommand.valid_until
fields.initialization: assigned on candidate export/commit and each command emission; message stream lease is now+100 ms by default
fields.meaning: candidate validity and emitted stream validity are distinct windows; receipt time and source state freshness are independently checked
writers: planner candidate export; publishCommand message builder
readers: commit/activation/publishIfCurrent; NavigationMode commandContractValidAt/updateSetpoint
fields.reset: expires by clock; no lease extension from stale sample; bounded recovery exceptions are identity-specific
fields.clock_unit: ROS ns; source and steady receive clocks also used
fields.identity: bundle generation and command sample id
fields.protection: immutable bundle + store lock; mode cache mutex

fields.name: ExecutionEpisodeSnapshot::phase / command_available / active_generation / safety_suffix_active / restart_from_rest
fields.initialization: reset to InitialHold, unavailable, no active generation; beginGoal may retain an existing command
fields.meaning: lifecycle, active authority and restart latch co-owned with recovery_state; more authoritative than free-standing mirror flags
readers: planning admission, sample policy, candidate commit, final exposure and diagnostics
fields.reset: exact generation/goal identity mutations; reset/failClosed clear ownership
fields.identity: localization_epoch, goal_epoch, request_id, active_generation
fields.protection: ExecutionEpisode mutex; compound runtime transitions also lock localization/input/lease transition

fields.name: PlanningKey identity tuple
fields.type: separate uint64 counters, enum start mode, int64 anchor stamp
fields.initialization: invalid zero counters; formed per schedulePlanningCycle snapshot
fields.meaning: localization epoch, goal epoch, request id, route revision, committed bundle generation, world generation/revision, start mode, anchor stamp and dynamics hash are distinct; none can substitute for another
readers: worker dedup/cancel, PlanningRequest validity, candidate output and commit recheck
fields.reset: new state/request/world/anchor forms a new key; old result rejected by current key checks
fields.clock_unit: anchor_stamp_ns in ROS time; no epoch unit conflation
fields.identity: all listed tuple components are independent fields
fields.protection: captured immutable value; inputs copied under runtime locks

fields.name: WorldSnapshotIdentity::localization_epoch/generation/revision/observation_stamp_ns
fields.initialization: set by mapping snapshot publication
fields.meaning: world version and freshness witness separate from goal/request/bundle identity
readers: planning request, recertification, candidate admission, activation, publish freshness gate
fields.reset: new observation/revision/generation replaces snapshot; epoch change invalidates prior lineage
fields.identity: localization epoch, world generation and revision, source observation stamp
fields.protection: immutable snapshot identity; WorldSnapshotStore synchronization

fields.name: ExecutionStateStore::state_ / ExecutionStateLease::ingress_sequence
fields.initialization: empty; first accepted finite KinematicState establishes active epoch
fields.meaning: latest immutable propagated state; monotonic source time and exact epoch gate publication; separate receive steady stamp and ingress sequence do not replace source-time freshness
readers: PlanningKey, candidate anchor, emergency check, publishCommand final lease gate
fields.reset: epoch reset clears exact cached lease
fields.clock_unit: KinematicState source_stamp_ns in ROS clock; receive stamp steady clock
fields.identity: localization epoch + ingress sequence; sequence is not freshness
fields.protection: ExecutionStateStore mutex and immutable shared snapshot

fields.name: trajectory_completion_witness_ / trajectory_reaches_goal_ / terminal_bundle_generation_
fields.type: optional witness + atomic bool + uint64 generation
fields.initialization: no witness / false / zero
fields.meaning: terminal sampling and goal endpoint lineage; endpoint sample alone does not mean mission accepted or complete
fields.scope: one candidate generation and goal request
writers: publishCommand only after matching completed sample; lifecycle/recovery/epoch reset clears
readers: currentPlanningKey terminal suppression, stopped hold predicate, terminal monitor admission
fields.reset: identity mismatch, goal/epoch change, new request/recovery clears
fields.clock_unit: witness source stamp and bundle valid window in ROS ns
fields.identity: active goal and exact terminal bundle generation
fields.protection: witness under transition locks; atomics use acquire/release

fields.name: new_goal_
fields.initialization: false
fields.meaning: request transition marker used by planner/terminal guard while desired and executing goals may differ
readers: currentPlanningKey, commit, terminal monitor and retained callback predicates
fields.reset: cleared after admitted successor cutover or rejected/invalidated request path
fields.identity: active goal and execution goal tuple
fields.protection: input_mutex_

fields.name: hot_goal_transition_
fields.initialization: false
fields.meaning: retarget planner through committed-future successor path while prior command remains active
readers: currentPlanningKey start mode, candidate stage/commit, terminal monitor
fields.reset: cleared at matching successor activation or fail-closed reset
fields.identity: desired request distinct from executing predecessor
fields.protection: input_mutex_ and command transition lock

fields.name: skip_replan_once_
fields.initialization: false
fields.meaning: one scheduler renewal suppressed after a stopped-state successful plan; a mirror, not recovery owner
writers: successful stopped-state plan; consume/reset in scheduler
readers: schedulePlanningCycle only
fields.reset: consumed by one planning scheduler pass or explicit reset
fields.identity: current goal identity indirectly via runtime guard
fields.protection: atomic; runtime transition sets related state

fields.name: foreign_mission_hold_after_stop_ / foreign_mission_cancel_pending_
fields.type: bool + atomic bool + target epoch tuple
fields.initialization: false/false/zero
fields.meaning: foreign mission change is treated as authority violation; moving certified suffix drains before fail-closed hold/cancel
readers: goal admission, stopped-recovery branch, worker cancellation guard
fields.reset: clear after target epoch cancellation consumed or lifecycle reset
fields.identity: foreign target, transition and localization epoch
fields.protection: localization/input/command lock order plus atomics

fields.name: tracking_experiment_ / TrackingExperimentPolicy
fields.type: policy with enabled/suppress flags and numeric coefficients
fields.initialization: loaded from parameters; enabled=use_sim_time; suppress_braking=use_sim_time && !trackingGateEnabled(); suppress_estimator_health_response=suppress_braking; default config coefficients are zero
fields.meaning: conditional experiment policy affects runtime tracking validation and mode geometric-tracking/health response; zero coefficients disable adaptive envelope but under use_sim_time=true cause suppress flags to be true
fields.scope: process configuration/launch profile, constant for process lifetime
writers: loadTrackingExperimentPolicy during both runtime and PX4 mode construction
readers: runtime retained/transition tracking validation; mode command admission and health check; optional velocity-only setpoint branch
fields.reset: construction only; no dynamic update found
fields.clock_unit: coefficients are metres/seconds; use_sim_time selects simulated profile
fields.identity: process launch parameters and use_sim_time; does not alter goal or bundle ID
fields.protection: immutable after construction; used in callbacks

fields.name: tracking_experiment_ / TrackingExperimentPolicy
fields.type: policy with enabled/suppress flags and numeric coefficients
fields.initialization: loaded from parameters; enabled=use_sim_time; suppress_braking=use_sim_time && !trackingGateEnabled(); the mapping.yaml coefficients are zero
fields.meaning: runtime experiment policy changes transition and retained-command tracking acceptance when enabled; this is a separate process-local copy from PX4 mode policy
readers: runCycle transition/path tracking, retained validation and emergency pressure calculations
fields.reset: constructor-only immutable process policy
fields.clock_unit: coefficients are metres/seconds; use_sim_time selects simulated policy
fields.identity: runtime parameter file and use_sim_time launch argument
fields.protection: immutable after construction

decisions.authority: NavigationRuntimeNode goal callback under localization/input locks, PendingGoalHandoffOwner for same-mission suffix deferral
decisions.effects: replace desired goal; possibly preserve executing predecessor or single-slot defer; cancel/queue solve

decisions.authority: NavigationRuntimeNode guards plus ExecutionTimelineStore atomic store operations
decisions.effects: successor pending until activation; emergency can cut over immediately; invalid candidates do not gain execution ownership
publish exact sampled identity if state/world/goal/leases/lifecycle still current; else drop, suspend or fail closed

decisions.sink: admit/reject NavigationCommand and feed mission progression
decisions.authority: NavigationMode::onNavigationCommand, serialized with mission timer under trajectory_mutex_
decisions.effects: cache exact message and notify MissionController; ROS message acceptance is not PX4 controller acceptance

decisions.authority: NavigationMode::updateSetpoint plus frame/health/lease gates; NavigationModeExecutor owns mode handover
decisions.effects: publish P/V/A/yaw setpoint inputs or stationary input; jerk is not sent in the PX4 setpoint; request AUTO_LOITER has separate API/status stages

transitions.predicate_before: MissionController is Idle/checkpointed; on activation it resets to WaitingForAirborne and has no admitted NavigationCommand.
transitions.event: PX4 external mode activation followed by the immediate mission timer update
transitions.guard: MissionController::update returns no goal while !airborne; airborne is isArmed() && local position z > 0.5 m. If armed/above threshold on immediate update, it enters ExecutingWaypoint and emits PublishGoal. A separate source comment claims first goal is published from onActivate; code plus unit test qualify that statement.
transitions.branch_priority: NavigationMode resets per-activation command/recovery/frame latches but retains process health/odometry samples; MissionController restores checkpoint if valid; update returns no goal until airborne; then goal acquisition precedes fresh command admission.
effects: publish NavigationGoal
stationary setpoint while bounded initial PVA acquisition
no evidence of PX4 applied command
transitions.concurrency: PX4 mode executor and state-input thread; trajectory mutex serializes command/timer snapshots; no total order across independent state input

transitions.predicate_before: goal tuple compared to current mission/order and localization epoch; safety suffix and foreign mission facts inspected
transitions.guard: valid route snapshot and monotonic same-mission identity; if safety suffix active, only newer ordered same-mission goal is deferred; foreign mission is held until stop/fail-closed
transitions.branch_priority: decode/validate then localization->input locks; stale/duplicate returns no-op; pending suffix branch before direct goal replacement; normal branch cancels/rekeys worker and advances goal epoch
effects: new goal can become desired before executing identity changes
queue/cancel planning request
pending pointer consumed only after matching execution handoff
transitions.concurrency: localization_epoch_ingress_mutex_ then localization_transition_mutex_ then input_mutex_; callbacks asynchronous across processes

transitions.predicate_before: localization ready, desired/execution identity and current world/state valid; no already-current terminal stop or failure guard
transitions.event: 5 Hz planning timer or explicit replan trigger
transitions.guard: PlanningKey exists and survives current-key recheck; queue policy accepts or replaces pending item
transitions.branch_priority: single serial worker; duplicate no-op; priority/replacement may interrupt active solve under worker mutex; latest pending job consumed after active exits
effects: solve can run while command sampling continues
planner result itself does not commit or publish
transitions.concurrency: planning and command timer callback groups/workers; worker serializes backend solve, runtime timers may execute concurrently

transitions.predicate_before: candidate uncommitted; active timeline and execution episode snapshot captured for optimistic recheck
transitions.event: planner returns candidate or emergency validation completes
transitions.guard: candidate.valid + identity/world/certificate/dynamics/anchor/lease guards and current predecessor/version/episode; normal successor staged when active; immediate measured emergency uses separate boundary; failed emergency certification applies EmergencyCertificationFailed and failClosed
transitions.branch_priority: invalid/stale/superseded rejects first; emergency boundary/admission differs; staged successor requires current exact timeline token and future activation
effects: candidate may be staged, committed or rejected; no claim that commit means sample/exposure/PX4 acceptance
transitions.concurrency: candidate preparation outside critical section; recheck/commit under localization->input->command locks and store version CAS

transitions.entrypoint: publishCommand timer -> activatePendingIfDueAndFinalize -> queued PlannerFacade history sync
transitions.predicate_before: pending candidate exists and ROS now reaches activation stamp; old active remains execution authority
transitions.event: command timer reaches staged activation boundary
transitions.guard: pending generation matches; epoch ready; lease latch allows; recovery state known and nominal allowed; failure false; desired goal tuple/goal epoch/localization epoch/pending goal exact
transitions.branch_priority: pre-guard failure drops or preserves active per store contract; successful store swap changes executing identity and episode; queued planner activation is synchronized in subsequent worker callback
effects: atomic store cutover for command timeline; planner history facade synchronization is a later queued side effect
desired, pending, active generation and planner history are not one distributed transaction
transitions.concurrency: localization/input/command locks plus timeline store lock; queue sync later

transitions.predicate_before: sample identity exact to active store; sample role from active timeline interval
transitions.event: ROS-time sample enters BACKUP or EMERGENCY suffix interval
transitions.guard: valid sample and exact active bundle/executing identity still current; no planned-stop-hold misclassification
transitions.branch_priority: stale sample dropped; valid sampled safety role synchronizes Episode recovery; backup is not main continuation
effects: command status/role encodes sampled execution role; MissionController only receives it after downstream admission
transitions.concurrency: command timer and runtime state callbacks are concurrent; exact pointer/generation recheck under transition locks

transitions.predicate_before: sample ready; source/receive state and world freshness, candidate and stream lease computed
transitions.guard: same active sampled pointer, goal/localization/world identity and episode; current state freshness, world freshness, message and bundle lease; stopped hold additionally requires known-free world and measured anchor proximity
transitions.branch_priority: lease failure latches/fail-closes; stale world suspends/revalidates; superseded sample drops; if all valid publish NavigationCommand; otherwise safety/rejected message branch
effects: ROS publisher gets exact command only after final gate; publication is not PX4 command acceptance
transitions.concurrency: timeline store serializes exposure with commit/revoke; lock chain and freshness re-read at linearization boundary

transitions.predicate_before: candidate ROS message not yet local cache; old admitted command may be retained
transitions.guard: contract, valid_until, frame, localization epoch, mission/wp/request or exact retained predecessor/suffix identity, world non-regression, sample monotonicity, state/health freshness, command role/phase and stop proximity checks
transitions.branch_priority: reject transition retains prior certified command when configured; terminal/handover/failure prevents reopening; only admitted message replaces cache and updates MissionController readiness/terminal facts
effects: local acceptance then timer/tick may advance mission; no direct guarantee PX4 used the command
transitions.concurrency: trajectory_mutex_ serializes this callback with updateMission mission timer

transitions.predicate_before: active waypoint/request, measured route-progress history, current admitted command continuation witness or certified backup stop witness
transitions.event: measured pass-through crossing or certified stopped-suffix acceptance
transitions.guard: trajectory ready/current witness and measured current segment crossing inside acceptance radius with fresh sample gap; suffix stop additionally low measured speed/near certified command; STOP coincident predecessor has separate terminal-readiness path
transitions.branch_priority: timer watchdog/recovery precedes controller update; no guard => no acceptance; accepted increments waypoint and request, emits new goal; old exact READY command may bridge handoff until lease expires/new admitted command
effects: new desired request published; executing predecessor can remain authoritative until candidate timeline swap; mission progress and planner progress are asynchronous
transitions.concurrency: mode command and timer serialized by trajectory_mutex_; ROS process message delivery asynchronous

transitions.predicate_before: STOP waypoint trajectory has endpoint/terminal witness or safety braking event; mission remains active
transitions.event: measured settle/confirmation/dwell or bounded safety timeout
transitions.guard: measured position inside acceptance radius; measured velocity <= configured acceptance speed; continuous confirmation window; hold dwell; pass-through safety path uses certified stop and 0.5 s confirmation or 5 s safety timeout
transitions.branch_priority: pending position-control event first; wait for trajectory end before safety confirmation; failure/missing trajectory requests position control; terminal STOP after hold_s emits Complete; nonterminal stop emits PublishGoal; safety timeout emits RequestPositionControl
effects: measured settle, waypoint acceptance, mission Complete and Hold request are distinct events
Complete publishes Bool/status and calls completed(Success); RequestPositionControl invokes Hold callback
transitions.concurrency: MissionController mutex; mode trajectory lock for update/event handling

transitions.entrypoint: runCycle measured-stop check -> applyExecutionRecoveryEventLocked(CertifiedStopObserved) / publishCommand planned stop hold
transitions.predicate_before: runtime recovery is TrackBackup or EmergencyBrake with active certified suffix; measured state/witness current
transitions.event: measured state meets stopped recovery criteria or sampled terminal safety stop
transitions.guard: exact active bundle/gen and state identity, freshness, stop envelope, world/certificate checks; unresolved/UNKNOWN does not grant restart
transitions.branch_priority: failed/unknown stop evidence keeps command fail-closed or existing certified suffix; valid stopped hold marks restart_from_rest; deferred same-mission goal can then be consumed/replanned; timeout follows configured runtime recovery path
effects: stopped recovery may schedule plan-from-rest; external PX4 mode has a separate 5 s completed-command recovery clock
transitions.concurrency: planning worker and command sampler concurrent; exact generation and episode checks; lock/store linearization not equivalent to complete cross-process transaction

transitions.entrypoint: runCycle emergency certification result -> recovery event + failClosedLocked
transitions.predicate_before: terminal MAIN/anchor check or emergency response requested; old command can be exceeded/invalid
transitions.event: emergency brake candidate fails certification or boundary validation
transitions.guard: emergency_certification_failed or emergency_boundary_failed after exact request/execution owner recheck
transitions.branch_priority: superseded/stale owner result discarded first; if still owner, failed certification sets recovery Px4Hold and fail-closes; no fabricated emergency trajectory
effects: publisher exposes rejected/terminal authorization status; PX4 mode then chooses safety stop/handover through its own status/mission path
transitions.concurrency: result callback rechecks captured timeline/episode/request under localization/input/command locks

transitions.predicate_before: incoming higher localization epoch or epoch/frame mismatch invalidates previous source-state lineage
transitions.guard: epoch is nonzero, monotonic; reset path clears readiness and drains/cancels old epoch data
transitions.branch_priority: set readiness false and cancel/invalidate old timeline/leases/episode/goal; require new consistent state/world before re-exposure
effects: old result cannot regain command authority after epoch transition; no claim of total cross-callback order beyond epoch locks/identity checks
transitions.concurrency: ingress->localization->input->command order; mapper drain and worker cancel around reset

transitions.predicate_before: PX4 local-frame alignment has prior reset-counter witness
transitions.event: PX4 XY/Z reset counter changes or initial stationary alignment pair arrives
transitions.guard: alignment requires active mode and stationary paired LIO/PX4 state within configured translation; reset invalidates latch
transitions.branch_priority: reset -> no aligned translation until re-established; setpoint path holds/blocks conversion; only then output transformed setpoint

authority_findings.decision: Mission progress and command execution identity are owned in separate processes and can temporarily name different request generations.
authority_findings.supporting_evidence: NavigationMode retains old accepted command without relabeling and runtime separates active_goal_ from executing_goal_; pending goal is a single exact-pointer suffix handoff; timeline activation changes executing identity.
authority_findings.counterexample_or_validity_mechanism: Distinct request/goal/localization/bundle identities, leases, and measured continuation/suffix-stop witnesses make this a deliberate asynchronous handoff; no one cross-process transaction exists.
authority_findings.synchronization: trajectory_mutex_ within mode; runtime lock order and store CAS within runtime; ROS message delivery between processes is asynchronous.
authority_findings.impact: A delayed/reordered goal or command can temporarily leave mission desired progress ahead of physical command owner; source contains identity guards but integrated delayed/reorder coverage is incomplete.
authority_findings.tests: test_navigation_mode_progression tests predecessor/current-request and stale witness behavior; runtime worker/store tests cover independent sub-boundaries; no integrated ROS two-process trace.

authority_findings.decision: Hold handover uses separate mode request, executor scheduling, API completion, and observed vehicle navigation state flags.
authority_findings.supporting_evidence: Only VehicleStatus AUTO_LOITER sets px4_hold_confirmed_; schedule API Success/Deactivated clears pending and in-flight without setting confirmed, while retry timer requires pending && !confirmed.
authority_findings.counterexample_or_validity_mechanism: PX4 mode API Success may be contractually followed by state transition; current source alone does not establish timing or guarantee. Failure results do retry every 250 ms; no maximum retry count is found.
authority_findings.synchronization: Executor timer/subscription/API callbacks; source does not show a shared explicit mutex for these flags; callback-group/executor serialization details require verifying PX4 library implementation.
authority_findings.impact: If API reports Success but AUTO_LOITER is never observed, source path stops retrying while confirmation remains false; this is a liveness risk hypothesis, not observed vehicle behavior.
authority_findings.tests: No targeted executor handover test located among reviewed tests; need controlled adapter test/trace capturing API result and VehicleStatus order.

authority_findings.decision: Runtime recovery and PX4 adapter recovery each have separate state, timer, identity, and terminal effects.
authority_findings.supporting_evidence: ExecutionEpisode owns runtime TrackBackup/Emergency/StoppedRecovery/Px4Hold; NavigationMode owns a separate 5 s completed-command recovery episode and its own suffix handoff/hold flags.
authority_findings.counterexample_or_validity_mechanism: The two processes handle different lifetimes and message boundaries; fields may be projections/replicas keyed by distinct goal/request/bundle identities, not duplicate authority.
authority_findings.synchronization: Message status/command contracts and exact identity lease checks; there is no shared cross-process transaction or common timer.
authority_findings.impact: Same episode can appear as runtime stopped recovery while PX4 adapter awaits a new command; timing mismatch can cause stale recovery or early handover if message identity changes; integrated sequence remains unobserved.
authority_findings.tests: Runtime episode and mode progression tests cover components; no paired-runtime/PX4 adapter scenario test in this review.

authority_findings.decision: SITL tracking/health response experiment activation is controlled by use_sim_time, and zero coefficients do not mean all bypass behavior is disabled.
authority_findings.supporting_evidence: loadTrackingExperimentPolicy sets enabled=use_sim_time; when all tracking coefficients are zero, trackingGateEnabled() is false, so simulated mode sets suppress_braking=true and suppress_estimator_health_response=true. Both runtime and PX4 mode read the policy. Source emits an explicit SITL increased-collision-risk/not-flight-qualification warning. Config comments say a zero tracking envelope disables tracking/health gates, while YAML zeros are present. Runtime runCycle selects the experiment acceptance result in place of the path-relative gate when enabled; `experimentPermitsTracking` allows out-of-envelope tracking if suppress_braking is true.
authority_findings.counterexample_or_validity_mechanism: Combined launch defaults use_sim_time=false; if selected run passes false, suppress flags stay false. For simulated profile use_sim_time=true, code sets suppress flags true despite zero coefficients. The actual launch args/runtime profile used by a live deployment are not known in this static audit. Combined launch argument use_sim_time defaults false, but the user-selected SITL launch may pass true; no active launch values were observable.
authority_findings.synchronization: Immutable policy loaded at process construction; runtime and PX4 mode are separate parameterized processes and can receive different parameter sets.
authority_findings.impact: Under SIM_TIME with zero tracking coefficients, runtime/mode may suppress the geometric tracking-brake/estimator-health response; the experiment logs characterize this as increased collision risk. This is code-proven for that parameter valuation, not an assertion that the live profile used it.
authority_findings.tests: Reviewed mode fixture asserts tracking_experiment_.enabled and suppress_estimator_health_response are false for its test configuration; no test specifically covers use_sim_time=true with zero coefficients across both processes.
